name: Men's Johnston & Murphy Melton Cap Toe Oxford, Adult, Size: 14 D, Bordeaux Brushed Calfskin
description: Step out in style in the Melton Cap Toe Oxford by Johnston & Murphy. This men's dress shoe is crafted of hand-selected calfskin for a premium look and feel. The Melton Cap Toe Oxford offers an exclusive Optima Comfort System with multi-layered cushioning ensuring comfort, support and flexibility. The leather lining keeps your feet relaxed and allows for all-day breathability. The lace-up closure offers an easy/personalized fit. This Johnston & Murphy dress shoe is equipped with Goodyear welt construction allowing leather to mold t your foot for a relaxed and unique fit. The leather outsole provides rubber covering at the heel, ensuring durable traction. Hand-Selected Calfskin Optima Comfort System Leather Lining Lace-Up Closure Goodyear Welt Construction. Size: 14 D. Color: Bordeaux Brushed Calfskin. Male. Age Group: Adult.
